text:
Alex: AM sync — quick bridge notes from overnight + current blockers. Warmed AMS preempt pool (+2 nodes). Saw an 18% spot eviction signal on g4b.4x around 03:10 UTC, autoscaler retried and we fell back to reserved capacity for ~12m.

Alex: Short logs: 
```
$ opsctl pool status ams-preempt
pool: ams-preempt
healthy: 24/30
eviction_signal: 18%
action: prewarm +2 nodes, fallback to reserved lane
```

Maria: Thanks — did the autoscaler hit any API rate limits or launch template errors?

Sam: Autoscaler hit a transient rate-limit on provider side (429) during the first retry. I requeued and it succeeded on attempt #3. No launch template drift observed.

Li: Noted. Can we add a runbook step for forced fallback if eviction_signal > 15% for >5m? Right now the playbook only mentions >20%.

Alex: Good call @Li. I saw increased token-latency for short-sequence requests after the fallback — suspect KV cache cold misses when switching lanes. Tracking perf in console.

Maria: I'll own the runbook update and add a link to the autoscaler retry metrics. Filing ticket INF-3421 and will attach the metric graphs.

Maria: Quick question for @Sam — can you paste the autoscaler event IDs so I can pin them in the ticket?

Sam: Sure: event ids `as-ev-1122`, `as-ev-1123`. Also attaching the autoscaler log snippet: 
```
[03:08:42] scale_request -> rejected (429) retrying in 10s
[03:08:52] scale_request -> accepted (200) node_count +2
```

ops-bot: deploybot: Autoscaler requeue registered at 03:08:52 UTC — tagged with incident:auto-scale.

Li: For follow-up: can we add a metric alert for short-seq p95 latency rising >30% within 10m of a lane switch? That would've caught the perf blip.

Alex: +1 on the alert. Also, FYI: AMS reserved pool has spare headroom of 4 nodes if we need manual bump.

Maria: I'll add both runbook step + alert to INF-3421. ETA EOD today.

Sam: No blockers from me — I put a small PR to improve retry backoff (PR #489). Please review when you have a sec.

Alex: Reviewing now. If anyone sees repeat evictions, ping me and we'll escalate to provider support.

Li: Marking follow-ups: INF-3421 (runbook + alert), PR #489 (autoscaler backoff), watchlist: ams-preempt pool.

Alex: Thanks team. If nothing else, I'm going to close this loop in the morning pass. :thumbsup:
